# SEO Audit Report: https://embryogenesis.in
**Generated by SearchFit.ai SEO Toolkit**. Live crawl done 2026-10-15. The site runs WordPress 7.0.4, Elementor 4.3.3 + Pro, the Astra theme, **Rank Math** (Yoast is not present), Forminator forms and LiteSpeed Cache 7.9.1.

## Executive Summary
- **Overall Score**: 38/100
- **Pages analysed**: 28. That is the 26 URLs in the sitemaps, plus the ERFA post that is missing from the sitemap and the author archive. I also ran a link check on 50 URLs and an image check on 66 images.
- **Critical issues**: 7 | **High**: 11 | **Medium**: 12 | **Low**: 8
- **Passing checks**: 14 (listed in "What's working")
- The site connection reset often during the crawl (curl error 35). Every fetch eventually succeeded on retry. The TTFB figures (about 1.3 s) were measured through the agent proxy, so treat them as rough indicators only.

## Score Breakdown
| Category | Score | Issues |
|---|---|---|
| Technical SEO | 45/100 | 11 |
| On-Page SEO | 35/100 | 10 |
| Content & Structure / E-E-A-T | 30/100 | 10 |

| Mobile & Accessibility | 55/100 | 5 |

## CRITICAL (fix immediately)

**C1. The flagship ERFA post canonicalises to a 404 and is missing from the sitemap**
- URL: `https://embryogenesis.in/erfa-the-soil-test-endometrial-receptivity-analysis-optimize-fertility-success/` (post ID 964, 729 words). It returns 200, and the blog, the ERFA category and two posts link to it.
- Evidence: `<link rel="canonical" href="https://embryogenesis.in//endometrial-receptivity-analysis">` and `og:url` carry the same value. That target redirects (301) to `/endometrial-receptivity-analysis`, which returns 404. Because of this bad canonical, Rank Math leaves the post out of `post-sitemap.xml`, which has only 5 posts.
- Impact: Google is being told to index a dead URL instead of the main article about the centre's patented test.
- Fix: In Rank Math > Advanced for post 964, clear the custom canonical, or set it to the post's own URL. Then resubmit the sitemap and request indexing in GSC.

**C2. The homepage loads about 21.6 MB of images (the "Our Patents" carousel)**
- In the "Our Patents" Elementor image carousel, seven full-size PNGs of 2.0 to 2.5 MB each (1536x1024) are loaded with no `loading=lazy`, no width/height, no srcset, and alt text like "ChatGPT Image Jun 18, 2026, 11...". Example: `/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/ChatGPT-Image-Jun-18-2026-11_51_04-AM-1.png` is 2,496 KB.
- More 2 MB PNGs in image boxes: `ChatGPT-Image-Jun-19-2026-02_41_35-PM.png` (1,997 KB) and `...03_47_26-PM.png` (2,155 KB). There are also "-scaled" 2560px WebP backgrounds of 242 to 450 KB.
- About page: about 4.7 MB of images.
- Impact: very poor LCP and Total Blocking Time on mobile, and heavy data use for Indian 4G users.
- Fix: Convert to WebP/AVIF at no more than 800px wide (target under 120 KB each). Use the "medium_large" image size in the carousel, set lazy-loading, and enable LiteSpeed image optimisation and WebP replacement.

**C3. The privacy policy is empty while forms collect personal and health data**
- `/privacy-policy/` has about 2 words of body text: just the heading "Privacy Policy".
- Three Forminator lead forms collect personal data with no consent checkbox or privacy link:
  - `/contact-us/` (form 935: name, email, phone, city, state, country)
  - `/bsc-in-clinical-embryology-in-bahra-university/` (form 1613)
  - `/skill-development-training/` (form 1458)
- Impact: risk under India's DPDP Act 2023 for a fertility (sensitive health) provider, a trust signal problem for YMYL, and Google Ads policy rejection.
- Fix: Publish a real privacy policy (data controller, purpose, retention, grievance officer). Add a required consent checkbox linking to it on every form, and link the policy in the footer.

**C4. A broken shortcode shows on the homepage, and the testimonials section is empty**
- The visible text "Testimonials [grw id=1198]" appears under the H2 "Real Stories, Real Smiles: Our Patients Speak". The Google Reviews widget plugin is deactivated or removed, so the shortcode prints as raw text.
- Fix: Reactivate or reconnect "Widgets for Google Reviews" (rich-plugins), or remove the section. Do not hand-code AggregateRating schema for your own reviews.

**C5. Many images return 404 site-wide, including the mobile menu logo on every page**
- `/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/EmbryoGenesis.png` returns 404. It is the ElementsKit off-canvas (mobile) menu logo and is broken on all 28 pages. Each request also triggers a 118 KB WordPress 404 page.
- Broken in-content images:
  - `/unexplained-infertility/`: 7 broken (all `2024/03/*.webp`, including its og:image)
  - `/tips-and-treatments-for-pregnancy-after-ivf-failure/`: 5 broken (`2024/07/*`)
  - `/exploring-lit-therapy.../`: `2024/05/lit-therapy-treatment.webp`
  - `/endometrial-immune-profiling.../`: `2025/07/Endometrial-Immune-Comparison_simple-1024x683.webp`
  - `/about/`: 7 partner/expert logos (`2024/12/VATSALYA_IVF_CENTER.webp`, `GIOSTAR.webp`, `Prof-Dr-Neena-Mehta.webp`, `Dr-Arunava-Bandyopadhaya.webp`, `Dr-Naveen-Chandra-Suryadevara.webp`, `DYET_NUTRITION.webp`, `ARCHISH.webp`)
- It looks like the 2023-2025 uploads were lost in a migration or cleanup. The post sitemap still lists 13 of these image URLs.
- Fix: Restore the uploads from backup, or re-upload and re-insert them. Also fix the double-slash URLs (see H5).

**C6. YMYL and regulatory claim risk**
- "Best" claims with no substantiation:
  - Title of `/contact-us/`: "Get in Touch For Best Infertility Diagnostics in India"
  - Title of `/diagnostic/`: "Best Infertility Diagnostics in India"; its meta description says "India's most accurate infertility diagnostics"
  - `/about/` meta description: "Best Infertility Diagnostic Center in India"; its body says "best fertility diagnostic centre in India"
  - Footer on every page: "As the best fertility centre..."
- `/advanced-fertility-therapies/` sells stem cell therapy as "revolutionary" and says it "Repairs and rejuvenates reproductive tissues". It also promotes LIT, PBMC, PRP and molecular hydrogen therapy.
  - Stem cell therapy for infertility is investigational under ICMR's National Guidelines for Stem Cell Research, which restrict promoting it outside approved trials.
  - ESHRE's RPL guideline advises against LIT.
- Uncited statistics:
  - "A study by the NIH showed that 92% of couples with unexplained infertility... had a child" (`/unexplained-infertility/`)
  - "8-10% increase in live birth rates" (LIT post)
- Fix:
  - Remove superlatives ("best", "most accurate"). This also matters under the Drugs & Magic Remedies Act and NMC/ASCI advertising norms.
  - Add citations to primary sources.
  - Add an "evidence status / investigational" disclaimer to the therapy pages.
  - Have a registered clinician give medical/legal sign-off before re-promoting the stem cell and LIT pages.

**C7. No analytics or tag tracking at all**
- None of the 28 pages has GA4/gtag, GTM, a Meta Pixel, Clarity or Site Kit, and no Search Console verification meta tag. GSC may be verified via DNS; please confirm.
- Impact: lead forms, tel: clicks and course applications cannot be measured.
- Fix: Install GTM with GA4 and consent mode. Track `generate_lead` (Forminator submit), `tel:` clicks, `mailto:` clicks and the brochure download.

## HIGH

**H1. The H1 structure is broken site-wide**
- 14 Elementor pages have no H1: bsc, art, profile, contact, media-event, courses, diagnostic, about, skill-development, advanced-therapies, research-and-training, blog, apply-now and 1 more.
- The homepage has 6 H1s. These are the 3 Prime Slider titles, rendered twice by the loop clones: "Advanced Fertility Solutions", "Build Skills, Shape Futures", "Shape Your Future in Embryology".
- `/unexplained-infertility/` has 2 H1s.
- Fix: Set the slider titles to H2 or p. Give each page exactly one keyword-focused H1, for example "Infertility Diagnostic & Research Centre in Mohali" on the home page.

**H2. Weak homepage title and no meta description**
- The title is "Home EmbryoGenesis" (18 characters) and there is no meta description.
- `og:description` and `twitter:description` are auto-filled with duplicated slider text.
- There is no `og:image` on the homepage, contact-us, media-event, research-and-training, blog, diagnostic-services, scholarship, privacy or apply-now.
- Fix: Use a title like "EmbryoGenesis | Infertility Diagnostics & Clinical Embryology Courses, Mohali" (about 60 characters), add a 150-160 character description, and set a 1200x630 OG image.

**H3. The Rank Math title separator is missing**
- Titles render as "Courses EmbryoGenesis", "Media & Event EmbryoGenesis", "Pulakes Purkait Profile EmbryoGenesis", "cache EmbryoGenesis". The %sep% variable is empty.
- Category archives use the theme's " – " instead.
- Fix: Set the separator ("|" or "-") in Rank Math > Titles & Meta > Global.

**H4. Missing meta descriptions on 13 indexable URLs**
- home, pulakes-purkait-profile, media-event, courses, diagnostic-services, clinical-embryology-scholarship, privacy-policy, apply-now, cache, and the 4 category archives.

**H5. Double-slash URLs in content and OG tags**
- Hard-coded `https://embryogenesis.in//...` in links (301):
  - `//contact-us/` on the EIP post
  - `//diagnostic/` on unexplained-infertility
  - `//unexplained-infertility/` on the LIT post
- og:image / twitter:image on all 5 posts use `https://embryogenesis.in//wp-content/...`. These redirect (301) and then 404, so social previews are broken.
- Fix: Do a search-replace on `embryogenesis.in//` to `embryogenesis.in/` with Better Search Replace / WP-CLI.

**H6. Thin, empty and junk indexable pages are in the sitemap**
- `/cache/` is an accidental post published 2026-08-14. Its body is only an oEmbed of the EIP post, its title is "cache", it is indexed and it is in the sitemap. Delete it with a 410, or 301 it to the EIP post.
- Main-content word counts for the empty pages (boilerplate removed):
  - `/apply-now/` (0 words, orphan)
  - `/clinical-embryology-scholarship/` (3 words, "Clinical Embryology Scholarship" only)
  - `/media-event/` (8 words: filter labels with empty `<a>` tags and no gallery)
  - `/diagnostic-services/` (20 words: an old template with "Special offer Get a free Appointment" and two "Book Appointment Now" buttons linking to `#`)
- `/research-and-training/` (63 words) is a list of patents. Its title, "Unexplained Infertility Solutions in India", does not match the content.
- Fix: Build these pages out, or noindex them and drop them from the sitemap, or 301 them. Specifically:
  - `/diagnostic-services/` → `/diagnostic/`
  - `/apply-now/` → `/courses/`
  - `/research-and-training/` → a new "Patents & Research" page with patent numbers

**H7. Orphan pages**
- These sitemap URLs have 0 internal inbound links: `/research-and-training/`, `/diagnostic-services/`, `/clinical-embryology-scholarship/`, `/privacy-policy/`, `/apply-now/` and all 4 category archives.
- `/art-and-clinical-embryology-in-rayat-bahra-university/` and `/pulakes-purkait-profile/` have only 1 inbound link each.

**H8. Broken and mis-routed CTAs and the booking flow**
- On the homepage, the "View Course" button for the "B.Sc. & M.Sc. in ART & Clinical Embryology With ITHS & Rayat Bahra University" card links to `/contact-us/`. It should go to `/art-and-clinical-embryology-in-rayat-bahra-university/`.
- The homepage slider "Explore More" buttons for the courses go to `/contact-us/` (4 instances).
- The site-wide header "Apply Now" links to `https://embryogenesis.in/courses`, with no trailing slash (301). That page has no form, so applying takes an extra hop.
- "Book Appointment Now" on `/diagnostic-services/` links to `#`.
- The "Book your test today" / "Book Now" buttons on `/diagnostic/` and `/advanced-fertility-therapies/` are `tel:` links only. There is no booking form or WhatsApp option for patients, and the home "Book Now" goes to a generic contact form.
- The "Download Brochure" link on the BSc page, `https://embryogenesis.in/Clinical_Embryology-Brochure-2025-2026-Bahra_University.pdf`, returns **404**.

**H9. Inconsistent NAP (name, address, phone)**
- Phone numbers:
  - Header: "9691736435 / 9815692195". Only 9691736435 is a tel: link, with no +91.
  - Footer: "+91 8146217196 / +91 9599877196", not linked.
  - Contact page: only +91 8146217196 (tel link).
  - Profile page has a malformed link: `href="tel:+9195998%2077196"` (it contains an encoded space).
- Four different numbers are published, with no label saying which is for patients, admissions or the lab.
- Emails: two free Gmail addresses (info.embryogenesis@gmail.com, embryogenesis.laboratory@gmail.com), plus director@translationalhealthscience.in on the profile.
- Address: "Top Floor, Rayat Bahra Dental College & Hospital, Mohali, Punjab", with no PIN code or locality (Sahauran / Kharar).
- The contact map iframe uses a text query (`maps.google.com/maps?q=EMBRYOGENESIS...`) rather than the place embed. The About page embeds a My Maps map.
- Fix: Pick one primary patient line and one admissions line. Make them consistent in the header, footer, contact page, Google Business Profile and schema. Use the `+91` format with tel links, and add the full postal address with PIN code.

**H10. No relevant structured data**
- The home graph is Rank Math's `["Person","Organization"]`, named "EmbryoGenesis", with only a 150x100 logo: no address, telephone, geo, sameAs or founder.
- Every inner page has only a 1-item BreadcrumbList.
- Missing schema types:
  - MedicalOrganization / DiagnosticLab, plus LocalBusiness/MedicalClinic with address and geo
  - Course and EducationalOccupationalProgram on the 2 degree pages, the skill training page and the courses page
  - Person (founder) on the profile, with alumniOf and sameAs (ORCID 0000-0002-8814-9939)
  - Article/MedicalWebPage on posts, with author, reviewedBy and datePublished
  - FAQPage, even though `/diagnostic/` and `/advanced-fertility-therapies/` contain FAQ sections. FAQ rich results are limited now, but the markup still helps AI answers.
- Fix: In Rank Math > Titles & Meta > Local SEO, switch to Organization with type MedicalOrganization and fill in the NAP. Add a Course schema template and a Person schema to the profile. Set posts to the Article type.

**H11. Weak E-E-A-T on YMYL content**
- All 5 posts are bylined to "embryosys", which is the WordPress admin login (also exposed at `/wp-json/wp/v2/users`). The author bio is empty and the author archive `/author/embryosys/` is indexed.
- No post has an external citation (0 outbound reference links), a medical reviewer, an "updated on" date or a disclaimer.
- The founder profile lists M.Sc., Ph.D. and Postdoc credentials (reproductive geneticist) but no registered medical practitioner. Meanwhile the site advertises therapies (LIT, PBMC, PRP, stem cell).
- No clinician names or NMC/State Medical Council registration numbers are shown anywhere.
- No lab accreditation (NABL) and no ART Act 2021 registration are shown.
- The "Our Patents" section shows AI-generated stock lab photos (for example `ChatGPT-Image-Jun-18-2026-11_28_50-AM.png`, a generic lab scene) with no patent numbers. Most site imagery is named `ChatGPT-Image-*`.
- Fix:
  - Create real author and reviewer profiles: Prof. Purkait plus a named MD/gynaecologist reviewer.
  - Add a "Medically reviewed by ... on [date]" line and a references list to every post.
  - List the patent application/grant numbers with links to the IPO.
  - Show registrations and accreditations, and use real photos of the lab and team.
  - Change the admin display name, and noindex the author archive or turn it into a real bio page.

## MEDIUM

1. **Render-blocking resources (homepage)**
   - 53 CSS files, 45 of them render-blocking in `<head>`, plus about 114 KB of inline CSS.
   - 25 external JS files (jQuery and jquery-migrate block in the head) and 13 inline scripts.
   - Three overlapping carousel stacks: Owl Carousel (Sina), Swiper (Elementor) and UIkit (Prime Slider).
   - Four icon fonts: Font Awesome 4 and 5 (both loaded), icofont, ekiticons and eicons.
   - Inner pages: 28-41 CSS files and 19-25 JS files.
   - Fix: In LiteSpeed, enable CSS/JS combine and minify, Load CSS Async + UCSS, and JS Delay. In Elementor, turn on Improved Asset Loading and disable Font Awesome 4 shims. Drop either Sina or ElementsKit, and drop Prime Slider for one native slider.
2. **Google Fonts bloat**: 4 families (Lato, Merriweather, Niramit, Poppins) are requested with all 18 weights/styles each. Limit to Poppins 400/500/600 and self-host (Elementor > Settings > Performance > Load Google Fonts locally).
3. **No LCP preload**: The only `fetchpriority=high` image is the 185 KB favicon-sized PNG `Untitled-design-3.png`. There is no preload for the hero image, and 8 homepage images have no width/height, which causes CLS.
4. **Wrong language markup on the Hindi post**: `/tips-and-treatments-for-pregnancy-after-ivf-failure/` is fully Hindi but has `<html lang="en-US">`, `og:locale en_US` and an English slug, and no hreflang.
   - Since it has no English equivalent, hreflang is optional, but set `lang="hi"` / `inLanguage: hi-IN` for this post. Polylang or TranslatePress can do this per post, or a `language_attributes` filter.
   - If an English version is published, add reciprocal hreflang `en-IN` / `hi-IN` plus `x-default`.
5. **Internal search results are indexable**: `/?s=ivf` returns `index, follow`. Set noindex for search results in Rank Math.
6. **Thin taxonomy archives are indexed and in the sitemap**: 4 categories with 54-240 words each. Posts sit in "Uncategorized" (`article:section` is Uncategorized). Recategorise the posts, and either add intro copy to the categories or noindex them.
7. **Keyword cannibalisation and mismatched meta**:
   - `/contact-us/` and `/diagnostic/` both target "Best Infertility Diagnostics in India".
   - The meta description of `/skill-development-training/` ("Infertility explained: causes, diagnosis...") does not match the page.
   - `/about/` and `/contact-us/` both use the "Best ... Diagnostic Centre in India" description.
   - The page title "Unraveling unexplained infertility in embryogenesis" is awkward.
8. **Image alt text**:
   - About page: 39 of 41 images have no alt.
   - Homepage: 16 of 23 images have no alt, and the carousel alts are auto-generated "ChatGPT Image Jun 18, 2026, 11...".
   - Footer logo has `alt=""` on every page.
   - Rename the files descriptively, e.g. `erfa-endometrial-receptivity-test.webp`.
9. **Content is stale**:
   - Footer reads "©2023. EMBRYOGENESIS. All Rights Reserved." on all pages; make the year dynamic.
   - Last blog post was July 2025, and there are 5 posts in total (one of which is junk).
   - The 2025-2026 brochure link is dead.
10. **No WhatsApp**: No wa.me / click-to-chat link anywhere. This is a standard conversion channel for Indian patients and admissions; add a floating WhatsApp button with GA4 event tracking.
11. **Broken or poor external links on the profile**:
    - LinkedIn URL ends in an encoded space (`.../pulakes-purkait-aa634094%20`).
    - The ResearchGate link points to the generic `researchgate.net/directory/profiles` page (403).
    - The "Bahra University" link `bahrauniversity.edu.in` redirects to `bushimla.in`.
    - `rayatbahrauniversity.edu.in` returned 522 (Cloudflare origin error) on two attempts.
12. **Breadcrumbs are one level deep**: the BreadcrumbList has only the current page, with no Home > Section. Enable Home in Rank Math breadcrumbs and set parent pages: courses as parent of the degree pages, diagnostic/therapies under Services.

## LOW

1. `twitter:card` is "summary" site-wide; switch it to `summary_large_image`.
2. 4 `target=_blank` links on the homepage lack `rel=noopener`.
3. Icon-only links have no accessible name: the header/footer logos, the social icons, the 4 `#` anchors on the homepage, and the carousel lightbox links. Add `aria-label`.
4. Security headers are missing: no HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options or Referrer-Policy. Static assets are cached for only 7 days; use 1 year with versioned files.
5. REST API user enumeration (`/wp-json/wp/v2/users` exposes "embryosys"). This is a security and hardening issue, not SEO.
6. Comments are open on `/unexplained-infertility/` with no anti-spam field, which is a spam risk on a YMYL page. The other posts have comments closed.
7. There is no `llms.txt` (404). Optional, for AI search visibility.
8. The "Media & Event" filter tabs ("All / Appreciation / Award / MOU / News") are `<a>` tags with no href and no gallery behind them.

## What's Working Well
- robots.txt is clean: it disallows only /wp-admin/, allows admin-ajax and references the sitemap.
- Rank Math sitemap index is valid. `/sitemap.xml` and `/wp-sitemap.xml` redirect (301) to it.
- Host canonicalisation is good: http, www and https-www all redirect (301) to `https://embryogenesis.in/`. Paths without a trailing slash redirect (301) to the slash version.
- A real 404 status is returned for missing pages.
- A self-referencing canonical is present on every page except the ERFA post.
- No accidental noindex on key pages.
- A responsive viewport meta tag (`width=device-width, initial-scale=1`) is present on all pages, and there is a skip link.
- HTML is served with Brotli/gzip compression (245 KB raw becomes 33 KB on the wire). LiteSpeed page cache is hitting.
- Good meta descriptions (137-159 characters) on 12 pages: the course pages, diagnostic, about, advanced therapies, blog and posts.
- Posts have a single H1 and logical H2s. The EIP post has a "Limitations" section, which is good balance for YMYL.
- The founder profile is substantial (713 words) and links to ORCID.
- The `/diagnostic/` (546 words) and `/advanced-fertility-therapies/` (683 words) service pages have real depth and FAQ content.
- Forminator forms have anti-spam fields.

## Next Steps (priority order)
1. Fix the ERFA canonical (C1) and delete or redirect `/cache/` (H6). Resubmit the sitemap in GSC. This takes about 15 minutes.
2. Install GTM + GA4 with lead, tel and WhatsApp events (C7). Add a WhatsApp button and fix the CTA routing and the 404 brochure (H8).
3. Compress and resize the 12 PNGs of about 2 MB and enable LiteSpeed CSS/JS optimisation (C2, M1-M3).
4. Restore the missing uploads and the mobile logo, and search-replace `embryogenesis.in//` (C5, H5).
5. Remove the broken `[grw]` shortcode or reconnect the reviews (C4). Update the footer year.
6. Publish the privacy policy and add consent checkboxes (C3).
7. Do the YMYL/legal clean-up: remove "best" claims, add citations, reviewers, clinician registrations and patent numbers, and add disclaimers on the stem cell and LIT pages (C6, H11).
8. Unify NAP and implement MedicalOrganization + LocalBusiness, Course, Person and Article schema (H9, H10).
9. Fix H1s, titles, the separator and the missing descriptions and OG images (H1-H4).
10. Build out or consolidate the thin and orphan pages, and set `lang="hi"` on the Hindi post (H6, H7, M4).
